Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: partial.

The core lifecycle works: drafts are reduced separately, SaveAndRun creates a revision/run barrier, and reducer tests cover attachments. The prescribed DraftLifecycleSuite and the Analysis scales-editor UI are absent, so the full named ticket/board slice is not demonstrated.

Evidence:
- studio/core/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/command/Reducer.scala:276 handles draft start/discard and :344 handles SaveAndRun
- studio/core/src/test/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/command/CommandReducerSuite.scala:45 asserts Save & run creates revision 5 and run 8
- docs/studio/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md:1157 names DraftLifecycleSuite; no such suite exists

Remaining / next action: Add the named end-to-end draft lifecycle test and complete the Analysis editor controls that create edits rather than only command-level coverage.

Disposition: Keep open.
